8.Name: Role
8.Description: PR, CI, Publish, CD or Other.

10.Name: Result
10.Description: succeeded, failed, canceled, partiallySucceeded or empty while running.

14.Name: PullRequestId
14.Description: Pull request id, 0 when the run has no pull request.

16.Name: ParentBuildId
16.Description: Parent run when this run was queued by another, 0 when none.

17.Name: Environment
17.Description: Target environment of a CD run.

19.Name: Platform
19.Description: Linux or Windows, from the agents that ran the jobs.

21.Name: Packages
21.Description: Packages built or installed, separated by semicolons.

22.Name: RequestedFor
22.Description: Who requested the run (per the identity mode of the collector).

29.Name: FailedTests
29.Description: Failed tests in the run, empty when the run has no test run.

30.Name: PackageCount
30.Description: Number of packages, empty when none could be determined.

33.Name: BuildId
33.Description: Azure DevOps build id of the run.

37.Name: StepName
37.Description: Name of the stage, job or task.

38.Name: ParentId
38.Description: Timeline id of the parent record.

39.Name: RecordType
39.Description: Stage, Job, Task, Checkpoint or Checkpoint.Approval.

40.Name: IsApprovalStage
40.Description: 1 when this stage matches a configured release approval stage, otherwise 0.

41.Name: Category
41.Description: detect, build, test, publish, deploy, cleanup, setup or teardown.

42.Name: Package
42.Description: Package of a Build or Pack step.

54.Name: ErrorCode
54.Description: Error code of the first error (empty when none).

55.Name: ErrorMessage
55.Description: Scrubbed first line of the first error.

75.Name: Commits
75.Description: Number of commits in the run.

76.Name: PullRequestIds
76.Description: Merged pull request ids found in the commit messages, separated by semicolons.

107.Name: FailingSinceBuildId
107.Description: Build id the test started failing in, 0 when unknown.

110.Name: DurationMs
110.Description: Test duration in milliseconds, empty when Azure DevOps reports none.

125.Name: WorkItemIds
125.Description: Linked work item ids, separated by semicolons.

126.Name: WorkItemTypes
126.Description: Linked work item types, separated by semicolons.

127.Name: AreaPaths
127.Description: Linked work item area paths, separated by semicolons.

131.Name: FirstReview
131.Description: First review comment by someone else (UTC).

135.Name: TimeToFirstReviewSeconds
135.Description: Seconds from creation to the first review.

136.Name: TimeToFirstApprovalSeconds
136.Description: Seconds from creation to the first approval.

137.Name: ApprovalToMergeSeconds
137.Description: Seconds from the first approval to the merge.

152.Name: TargetPackageVersion
152.Description: Value of the TargetPackageVersion work item field alias (empty when not collected).

153.Name: VersionMismatch
153.Description: 1 when the target version does not match the branch version.

154.Name: DoneWithoutVersion
154.Description: 1 when the work item is done without a target version.

169.Name: TargetPackageVersion
169.Description: Value of the TargetPackageVersion work item field alias (empty when not collected).

170.Name: VersionMismatch
170.Description: 1 when the target version does not match the branch version.

171.Name: DoneWithoutVersion
171.Description: 1 when the work item is done without a target version.

174.Name: InitialIterationPath
174.Description: Iteration path when the pull request was created.

175.Name: Resolver
175.Description: Who resolved the work item (per the identity mode).

176.Name: StoryPoints
176.Description: Story points of the work item (as estimated when resolved, else current); NULL when not estimated. Repeats on every PR row of the same work item, so count it once per work item (see StoryPointsCounted in the data set). Whole points only.

177.Name: IterationChanges
177.Description: Iteration changes since the pull request was created.

178.Name: CarriedOver
178.Description: 1 when the work item moved to another iteration.

179.Name: HistoryAvailable
179.Description: 1 when the revision history was read.

180.Name: MergedNotDone
180.Description: 1 when merged but not done after the grace period.

193.Name: PreviousState
193.Description: State before the change (empty on creation).

195.Name: PreviousIterationPath
195.Description: Iteration path before the change (empty on creation).

200.Name: ChangedBy
200.Description: Who changed it (per the identity mode).

202.Name: InPreviousStateSeconds
202.Description: Seconds the work item spent in the previous state.

211.Name: Team
211.Description: Team (from the iteration path); empty when the item is not in a team iteration yet.

213.Name: Milestone
213.Description: Milestone field of the item (for example Alpha); empty when not set. Can hold several values.

214.Name: ParentId
214.Description: Parent work item id, 0 when none.

215.Name: FeatureId
215.Description: Nearest Feature above the item, 0 when none.

217.Name: EpicId
217.Description: Topmost Epic above the item (the root of nested Epics), 0 when none.

219.Name: Done
219.Description: 1 when the item is done (a done state, or Resolved/Closed Date set); a Removed item is never done.

220.Name: Removed
220.Description: 1 when the state is Removed (out of scope).

221.Name: StoryPoints
221.Description: Story points; NULL when not estimated. Whole points only.

223.Name: ResolvedAt
223.Description: Resolved Date (UTC); empty when not resolved.

224.Name: ClosedAt
224.Description: Closed Date (UTC); empty when not closed.

225.Name: DoneAt
225.Description: When the item became done (Resolved Date, else Closed Date, else the last state change); empty when not done.

231.Name: Title
231.Description: Work item title at the revision.

232.Name: State
232.Description: Work item state at the revision.

233.Name: Version
233.Description: Package version of the release, from the latest title (for example 1.2.3).

234.Name: Line
234.Description: Branch that carries the release: from --branchVersions, otherwise development for x.y.0 and release/x.y for patch releases.

235.Name: ReleaseKind
235.Description: Roadmap or GoLive, from the latest title.

236.Name: ParentId
236.Description: Parent (Epic) work item id, 0 when none.

237.Name: ChangeKind
237.Description: Set (first dates), Start, Target, StartAndTarget, Cleared or State (the latest revision when only the state changed; the dates repeat the current ones).

238.Name: StartDate
238.Description: Start Date after the change = code freeze (UTC); empty when cleared.

239.Name: TargetDate
239.Description: Target Date after the change = planned release (UTC); empty when cleared.

240.Name: PreviousStartDate
240.Description: Start Date before the change; empty on the first row.

241.Name: PreviousTargetDate
241.Description: Target Date before the change; empty on the first row.

242.Name: StartShiftDays
242.Description: Days the Start Date moved (negative = earlier); empty when not comparable.

243.Name: TargetShiftDays
243.Description: Days the Target Date moved (negative = earlier); empty when not comparable.

244.Name: ChangedBy
244.Description: Who changed it (per the identity mode).

250.Name: Version
250.Description: Package version taken from the tag name (for example 2.47.0).

251.Name: Line
251.Description: Branch that carries the release: from --branchVersions, otherwise development for x.y.0 and release/x.y for patch releases.

254.Name: ReleasedAt
254.Description: Release day (UTC): date in the tag name, else annotated tag date, else push date, else commit date.

255.Name: TaggedAt
255.Description: When the annotated tag was created (UTC); empty for lightweight tags.

256.Name: PushedAt
256.Description: When the tag was pushed to the server, i.e. created in Azure DevOps (UTC); the latest push of the tag; empty when unknown.

257.Name: CommitAt
257.Description: Commit date of the tagged commit (UTC).

262.Name: MergeCommit
262.Description: Merge (or squash) commit the changes were read from.

263.Name: TargetBranch
263.Description: Target branch of the pull request.

264.Name: Closed
264.Description: When the pull request was completed (UTC).

270.Name: UiTestFiles
270.Description: Changed UI (GUI, page objects) test files.

272.Name: OtherTestFiles
272.Description: Changed test files of no specific kind.

273.Name: BusinessFiles
273.Description: Changed business logic files (services, orchestration, DEEs).

275.Name: MasterDataFiles
275.Description: Changed MasterData files (data package, database scripts).

277.Name: OtherFiles
277.Description: Changed files that match no rule (pipelines, config, docs).

278.Name: TestOnly
278.Description: 1 when the pull request changed files and all of them are test files, else 0.

288.Name: RequestId
288.Description: Job request id (monotonic: a lower bound on it prunes granules, like BuildId).

290.Name: Agent
290.Description: Agent that ran the job (unassigned when none).
